gaps.explanation: Statement lines are the Total Proprietary Funds column of the Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Net Position - Modified Cash Basis - Proprietary Fund (p11, printed p15): total operating revenues 4,905,348 (charges 4,490,788 + sales taxes 399,395 + miscellaneous 15,165) + interest and investment revenue 101,170 + capital grant contributions 95,000 + insurance claims reimbursements 13,773 + employee benefit claim receipts 155,949 = 5,271,240. Detail is the ACCRUAL-basis Enterprise Fund Accounts combining schedule (pp15-16, printed pp51-52): total operating revenues 4,901,393 (charges 4,487,277 + sales taxes 398,951 + miscellaneous 15,165) + interest 100,116 + federal grants 95,000 + employee benefit claims 152,611 + insurance proceeds 13,773 = 5,262,893. Gap 8,347 = charges 3,511 + sales taxes 444 (= operating revenues 3,955, accrual vs cash) + employee benefit claims 155,949 vs 152,611 = 3,338 + interest 1,054 printed in the p11 Internal Service Fund column (101,170 = Enterprise 100,116 + Internal Service 1,054). 3,955 + 3,338 + 1,054 = 8,347. The Internal Service Fund line is not added: user ruling 2026-11-13 (FY2023) - internal service funds are not added; and the remaining 7,293 is a printed basis difference that no detail line can close. No fix.
